_meta.notes: CHUNK-FILE FLAG RESOLVED — schedule_a was 'not-inspected (the Schedule A page was not among the pages read)'. INSPECTED: p3 IS a county-grid Schedule A, filled in by hand, 3 contributor rows, page subtotal printed and closing exactly. Nothing about the filing is un-inspected now; all 4 pages were rendered and read. Candidate (JIM BRADLEY), office (County Council), seat (At-Large C — the cover writes 'SLCo Council AT-LARGE C' in the Office cell and 'Council At-Large C' in Office Sought), date (2018-06-13, the signature date) and reporting_period ('Seven days before a primary election', the checked box) are all CONFIRMED at the page; the listing label 'June' is a month, not the form's period, and the form governs. Received stamp: JUN 14 2018. form_year '2018' matches the report period here — no vintage-year mismatch on this filing. || ⚠ A 2008 DATE ON A 2018 REPORT — p4 line 1 reads '6-5-08', escalated to 1200 dpi where the final pair is unambiguously a round 0 followed by an 8 (contrast the same filer's '5-23-18' and '4-14-18' on the rows below, which open with a clear vertical 1). Every other row on the page falls between 4-14-18 and 6-11-18. This is a WELL-FORMED FILER TYPO, so per the standing rule it is kept VERBATIM as 2008-06-05 and is NOT completed, corrected, or blanked. A human may want to read it as 2018-06-05; the repo does not make that call. || ⚠ THE ROW-3 CENTS GLYPH, and how it was decided (this is the one judgement call in the chunk). p3 row 3 (DALE COX, 100) has cents that read '.80' at 200 dpi and STILL read like an 8-then-0 at 1200 dpi. It is transcribed as 100.00, on two independent grounds. (1) ARITHMETIC, which outranks any glyph re-read: four printed figures on this filing — the page SUBTOTAL, the schedule TOTAL cell, Summary line 1 Column A and Summary line 4 — all read 1,600 exactly, and 1,000.00 + 500.00 + 100.80 would be 1,600.80. (2) The filer's own LETTERFORM, exposed by the same escalation: on p3 rows 1 and 2 the SUPERSCRIPT cents (which must be '00', since those rows are 1,000 and 500 within a 1,600 subtotal) are written as a joined pair that renders exactly like '80' at this scan quality — the first zero carries a horizontal joining stroke that closes it into a figure-eight. The same hand produced row 3's inline cents. So the glyph is the filer's '00', not '80'. Recorded at amount cell_confidence=medium with the reasoning in the row note; a human reviewer should be pointed at this cell. || The same '00'-that-looks-like-'80' letterform recurs on p4 (rows 1 and 2 carry superscript cents over a rule) and is why 4,800.00 on p4 row 2 was also escalated: at 1200 dpi the dollars are unambiguously 4800, and the sum confirms it (any other reading breaks the 7,520.00 subtotal). || PRIVACY — THE COUNTY'S REDACTION BOX UNDER-COVERS ON p3, the class already documented in PRIVACY.md for the clerk-legacy era. The black box covers the Complete Mailing Address column for all three rows, but a fragment of the address block escapes past its right edge into the left margin of the Occupation cell on rows 1 and 2 (a bare street-number-shaped digit group on row 1, a street-type abbreviation on row 2). Both are ADDRESS ink: they are discarded at read time, are NOT part of the occupation values, and are written nowhere in this record — not in donor_raw, not in occupation, not verbatim in a note. donor_city/donor_state are blank on all three rows with 'redacted at source' in each note. This is a finding about the county's published copy, not about the transcription. || The cover's own street-address block and the phone/fax/email strip are also barred. || FORM HEADER BOXES: on pages 2, 3 and 4 the 'Page __ of __ / Candidate or Officeholder's Last Name / Date of Report' box is entirely EMPTY — the filer never filled it in (contrast the Gill and DeBry filings in this chunk, which complete it on every page). Page identity here rests on the PDF order and on the form's own section titles. || Both schedules are the county's own ruled grid filled in by hand — shape 'county-grid' on both sides, no attachment anywhere in the 4-page document, and no 'Other Campaign Accounts' pages in this vintage. || Summary Page Column B line 1 (22,210.00) is written ABOVE a struck-through earlier figure that the strike renders illegible — the surviving handwritten value is the one recorded, the strike is noted here, and the struck figure is NOT guessed. Column B line 2 (17,505.98) has its final digit written over another digit; the value is recorded as it finally reads, at medium confidence. Column A lines 1 and 2 are written without cents ('1600', '7520') and are kept verbatim in that form; lines 4 and 6 restate the same two figures WITH cents (1600.00, 7520.00), which is the internal corroboration for both.

contributions.detail: 3 rows sum to 1,000.00 + 500.00 + 100.00 = 1,600.00, and FOUR printed figures agree with it: the page SUBTOTAL (1,600), the schedule's TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED cell (1,600), Summary line 1 Column A (1600) and Summary line 4 (1600.00). See the notes for the row-3 cents glyph that this four-way agreement settled.

expenditures.detail: 7 rows sum to 100.00 + 4,800.00 + 1,120.00 + 200.00 + 500.00 + 500.00 + 300.00 = 7,520.00 = the page SUBTOTAL (7520.00) = the schedule's TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE cell (7520.00) = Summary line 2 Column A (7520) = Summary line 6 (7520.00). Unlike the DeBry filing in this same chunk, this filer used the schedule grand-total cells for the sum of page subtotals rather than for the cycle aggregate, so schedule total and Summary figure coincide on both sides.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: BOTH page-subtotal gates fired and BOTH are EXACT. p3: rows 1,000.00 + 500.00 + 100.00 = 1,600.00 = printed SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE 1,600. p4: rows 100.00 + 4,800.00 + 1,120.00 + 200.00 + 500.00 + 500.00 + 300.00 = 7,520.00 = printed SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE 7520.00. On both pages the schedule's own grand-total cell repeats the subtotal, giving a second, independent printed anchor.
